name: eos-recon
description: Recon Agent role. Before ANY coding: search existing code, capabilities, procedures, DB schemas, tests, evidence, previous decisions. Output: REUSE | MINIMAL FIX | MISSING | BLOCKED. Prevents legacy accumulation and duplicate work.
author: EOS Development Team
trigger: Before any implementation agent writes code

inputs: work_id: string - Target work item identifier
workspace_path: string - Root path of codebase to scan
outputs: recon_report_json: string - Path to saved recon report
reuse_percentage: float - Percentage of reusable primitives
blocker_analysis: object - Blocked status and reasons

risks: Duplicate work creation if recon skipped
risk_assessment.mitigation: Mandatory recon before any code modification

authority_boundaries: Read-only access to codebase, no file modifications
Can only write recon reports to .eos-state/recon/
Cannot modify locked directories: packages/eos-core/foundations/, src/eos/semantics/
